paragraphs: I work at the point where analytics, reporting and data engineering meet. At Apex Informatics I built a Power BI dashboard that tracks 20+ operational KPIs and consolidates data from 5+ internal sources with SQL and ETL workflows.

At Elevate Credit I owned the lifecycle of 10-12 active models. I automated their stability and performance tracking (PSI, AUC, KS, lift) in a Snowflake-to-Power BI pipeline, which cut execution time by 95%.
I also designed charge-off, roll-rate and re-parameterization views used for pre-rollout lift analysis, and I built a fact-and-dimension reporting database from scratch.
Outside of work I write small, tested Python projects on evaluation and statistical rigor, such as leakage-aware cross-validation and fairness slice auditing.
